Worrells is a fast growing, specialist accounting firm with expertise in solvency management and insolvency administration. We have carved a successful niche in the small to medium enterprise market by delivering quality service and processes with our unique systems. Established in 1973, Worrells now have 36 principals in 28 locations across NSW, QLD, ACT, VIC and WA, we draw upon broader resources and technical expertise enabling us to be focused locally while being resourced nationally.

We are looking for a full time Insolvency Accountant to join our NSW/ACT team based in Parramatta NSW. The successful candidate will be responsible for:

Day to day file management of insolvency appointments (from start to finish)
Preparation of statutory lodgements
Liaising with directors, employees, creditors, banks, statutory authorities and other stakeholders
Collection and investigation into records
Prioritise and manage workloads to meet conflicting deadlines
Analyse financial statements and diverse financial data
Drafting of reports and preparation of creditors meetings
Investigations into insolvent trading, voidable transactions and offences committed by officers
Attending sites to inspect, collect and record assets and books and records
Assisting with Fair Entitlements Guarantee claims and calculating employee entitlements.

We are seeking a candidate who has:

Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office (Words, Excel, Outlook)
A Bachelor Degree or equivalent in Commerce, Finance or Accounting
Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal)
CA or CPA qualified (or willing to obtain)
ARITA Introduction to Insolvency certification
ARITA professional qualification (or willing to obtain)
Previous experience in insolvency is required.

We understand the importance of work-life balance, and we offer flexibility to support your needs. You'll become part of a collaborative team of professionals who are dedicated to both their work and personal growth. We provide opportunities for ongoing learning and development, and you'll have access to resources that will help you advance in your career. Worrells is committed to your professional growth, and we'll provide the support you need to succeed.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Data Business Analyst

Shape the future of data-driven healthcare at Epworth

At Epworth, Every Patient Matters. We are looking for a highly capable Data Business Analyst to join our team and play a key role in advancing our journey towards becoming a truly data-driven organisation. Working closely with business leaders, technical teams and reporting analysts, you'll transform business challenges into practical data solutions that improve decision-making and deliver meaningful organisational outcomes.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Data and Decision Support, you will partner with stakeholders across the business to understand priorities, define requirements and design data solutions that support strategic objectives. You'll work at the intersection of business, technology and analytics, helping turn complex data into actionable insights that drive performance across Epworth

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Data Business Analyst who enjoys stakeholder engagement, solution design and project delivery in a collaborative healthcare environment.

You will:

Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities, define business problems and gather requirements

Translate business needs into clear user stories, process maps, business rules and technical documentation

Work closely with Reporting Analysts and Data Governance teams to develop meaningful reporting, KPIs and dashboards

Support solution design, business case development and data-led decision making

Contribute to project delivery across Agile and Waterfall environments

Facilitate testing, user acceptance activities and stakeholder engagement

Deliver training, documentation and support to improve data literacy across the organisation

Position Description Inherent Requirement

About You

You will be a highly capable and motivated professional with strong interpersonal, organisational and stakeholder management skills, supported by excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Self-motivated and adaptable, you will thrive in fast-paced environments, demonstrate sound judgement and integrity, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and be committed to continuous improvement, quality outcomes and exceptional customer service.

To be successful, you will have:

Tertiary qualifications in Business, Data, Information Systems or a related discipline

Business Analysis qualifications or equivalent experience

3+ years experience in Business Analyst roles, with strong background in healthcare

Strong requirements gathering, process mapping and stakeholder engagement skills

Experience exploring and validating data using SSMS, BigQuery or similar cloud data platforms

Knowledge of healthcare operations, performance drivers and reporting environments

Experience working within Agile and project delivery frameworks

Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences

Experience with dashboard and reporting development will be highly regarded

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful impact. If you're passionate about using data to drive better decisions and outcomes in healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

At Epworth, it's a community

It's the sense of belonging and being part of an organisation and a team that works to make sure that every patient matters. In addition to this, you will have access to:

Salary package up to $15,900 pre-tax annually, leading to greater take home pay

The largest educational scholarship program of its kind in Australia

Ability to purchase up to four additional weeks of leave

Reduced cost of health services for you and your family at Epworth

Relocation assistance is available for approved candidates

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. This includes First Nations peoples, people with disability, mature-age and young job seekers, members of the LGBTIQA+ community, and individuals from all cultural backgrounds. We are committed to providing an equitable, inclusive, and barrier-free recruitment experience for everyone.

If you need support during the application process or would like to discuss reasonable adjustments, we encourage you to let us know what you need to participate fully and confidently. We understand that sharing your needs can feel daunting, so please know that any information you provide will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and respect.

Apply now

As part of the application process, please also respond to the following selection criteria questions in your cover letter:

Key Selection Criteria Questions

What experience do you have working with healthcare data, hospital operations or healthcare performance reporting?

Have you used SQL, SSMS, BigQuery or similar tools to explore and validate data sources? Please provide an example.

What experience do you have working within Agile or project delivery environments?

Please advise your availability to commence employment and any notice period required.

Please outline your salary expectations (exclusive of superannuation).

For more information about the role, refer to the attached position description or contact talent@epworth.org.au or call (03) 9426 0606.

Ready to make a difference? Apply now and help us deliver smarter, data-driven healthcare solutions.

Apply now! Click I'm Interested and submit your CV and cover letter as a single document including brief responses to the selection criteria questions above.

Early applications are encouraged - shortlisting will commence immediately.

Apply now. we've over 8,000 perspectives at Epworth and we're ready to welcome yours!

result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     In this full-time role, based in Richmond, the Applications Support Analyst is responsible for the execution of activities required to support and maintain applications within the Application portfolio, of the Digital and Technology division of Epworth Healthcare.

The Applications Support Analyst is part of a larger team providing support for all cloud and on prem applications ensuring they work as designed, are maintained and available as required.

The Applications Support Analyst is responsible for the day to day execution of assigned tasks required for providing support, upkeep and maintenance of the application portfolio in line with agreed and implemented best practices and service levels. 

You will make an impact by:

Providing ongoing maintenance of the Epworth application portfolio, including all support required for the successful operation of applications to meet service expectations.

Engagement of the Epworth applications management practices, processes and systems to improve the delivery of the application portfolio to meet the client satisfaction KPI's.

The triage of all escalated Incidents, request for change, problems, errors and service requests. The undertaking of addressing with the view to restore service of all assigned support calls.

Providing an acceptable workaround to the Epworth users in a prompt fashion if a resolution is not readily available.

Assist with the implementation and-or upgrade of systems

Ensure that integrations are monitored, functioning correctly and issues are resolved or escalated where required.

To be successful in this role.

You will be someone with experience in delivering and managing cloud technologies and a willingness to bring innovative ideas, new approaches to existing practices and a diverse mindset to the team.

You will have:

Knowledge in application development and-or technical support

Knowledge in application architectures with technical and functional experience with enterprise level application portfolios, including working with COTS, SaaS, delivered solutions.

Demonstrated understanding in implementing software applications including software packaging, configuration and scripting in a Hybrid environment

Knowledge of middleware and integration technologies.

Strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

2+ years IT industry with experience in delivery, software support and-or development

Tertiary qualifications in a relevant discipline and or equivalent mix of education and relevant experience within application development and-or support

Extensive information systems and supervisory management experience in a complex organisation, preferably within the Health Sector or similar

ITIL qualifications with service management experience in an operational environment, desirable

Certifications in relevant field, desirable

Position Description Inherent Requirements

We will review applications as we receive them.

At Epworth, it's a community. It's the sense of belonging and being part of an organisation that puts the patient in the centre of all that is done. In addition to this, you will have access to:

Epworth's enhanced Not for Profit status ( provides the opportunity for employees to salary package up to $15,900 pre-tax annually, leading to greater take home pay

The largest educational scholarship program of its kind in Australia

Ability to purchase up to four additional weeks of leave

Reduced cost of health services for you and your family at Epworth

At Epworth, we care.

We care about our patients and we care about our people. We care about keeping everyone safe. We care about valuing and empowering our people, and growing careers. And we care about giving our people support and flexibility to thrive, and contribute to our communities.

Enquire - Apply

Sound interesting? To apply, click the I'm Interested button and attach your CV and cover letter.

For more information, refer to the attached position description or contact Epworth Talent on (03) 9426 0606.

It is a condition of employment with Epworth HealthCare, subject to reasonable exemptions, that you have had an annual Influenza vaccination, where this is required under Epworth policy.

As a child safe organisation, all successful applicants are required to satisfactorily clear a National Police Check (conducted by Epworth) and may be required to hold a valid employee Working with Children Check (provided by you).

At Epworth, we believe inclusion and diversity are essential to our culture and values. We focus on fairness and opportunity for all - across race, ability, ethnicity, gender, age, sexuality, cultures and beliefs - that reflect the communities we work in. At Epworth, we care.
